hotel.name: Ionia Hotel
hotel.description:
Holidays to the Sporades are all about beautiful beaches, crystal-clear waters, and scenic landscapes. And offering a healthy dose of Greek hospitality, as well as a relaxed atmosphere, Ionia Hotel in Skopelos Town could be just the island escape you’ve been searching for.

Majoring in holidays of the fly-and-flop variety, this is a great place to just kick back and unwind. Picture lazy days spent flitting between the pool and your nearby sun lounger, complete with a stack of holiday reading and a cold drink from the nearby snack bar. Don’t fancy being holed up in the hotel? With Skopelos Town on the doorstep you won’t be short on things to do, whether it’s exploring the charming streets – and filming locations for Mamma Mia! – or hopping on a ferry to nearby Skiathos.

Sucker for souvlaki? You can expect to find plenty of local tavernas serving up authentic Greek eats in town, so make sure you pack your appetite.

Just so you know, this transfer includes a ferry crossing of approximately one hour. You will be taken from Skiathos Airport to the Port of Skiathos to catch the next available crossing. You may need to wait up to three hours at the port, depending on the ferry schedule. Your belongings can be stored locally if needed. A ferry will then transport you to Skopelos Island. From there, you'll take a transfer from the port of Skopelos to your chosen hotel. In the event of adverse weather conditions, where ferries are unable to operate, guests will be accommodated overnight in Skiathos before continuing to Skopelos the following day. The same applies for your return journey.
hotel.ksp1: Swimming pool with poolside snack bar
hotel.ksp2: Walking distance to bars and tavernas of Skopelos Town

hotel.name: Poseidon Studios
hotel.description:
Two minutes’ stroll from a pebbled stretch of shoreline that sits in a quiet cove, Poseidon Studios has got peaceful escape written all over it. There are only a handful of rooms here, so you can expect a friendly atmosphere along with a generous helping of peace and quiet.

Stroll 15 minutes in one direction and you’ll find yourself in the island’s capital of Patitiri– a dreamy little harbour village that boasts whitewashed streets, a small-but-perfectly-formed beach, and a slew of charming tavernas and cafés. Stroll 15 minutes from Poseidon Studios in the other direction, meanwhile, and you’ll find yourself in the equally charming – and equally sleepy – village of Votsi. Home to one of the island’s most beautiful bays, you can expect crystal-clear waters dotted with local fishing boats.

There’s plenty of exploring to be done on this shore, but with the harbour in Patitiri practically on your doorstep, you’d do well to hop on a ferry and visit a few neighbouring islands during your stay. Head for Peristera where you can spy a shipwreck or make for Skopelos and see if you can scout out the filming locations for Mamma Mia!

Just so you know, this transfer includes a ferry crossing of approximately two hours. You will be taken from Skiathos Airport to the Port of Skiathos to catch the next available crossing. You may need to wait up to three hours at the port, depending on the ferry schedule. Your belongings can be stored locally if needed. A ferry will then transport you to Alonissos Island. From there, you'll take a transfer from the port of Alonissos to your chosen hotel. In the event of adverse weather conditions, where ferries are unable to operate, guests will be accommodated overnight in Skiathos before continuing to Alonissos the following day. The same applies for your return journey.

hotel.name: Myriam Studios
hotel.strapline: HILLTOP RETREAT OVERLOOKING THE AEGEAN SEA
hotel.description:
For a taste of the tranquil life, book a stay at the Myriam Studios on the postcard-pretty isle of Alonissos. These simple yet spacious studio rooms not only provide plenty of home comforts but place you just a 10-minute stroll from the nearest beach, too.

And what a beach it is: a small stretch of sand and pebble with crystal-clear waters that are gently warmed by the afternoon sun. You’ll find a handful of tavernas and restaurants along the coast here, as well as lines of sun loungers if you fancy taking some time out to top up your tan.

Looking to explore? The capital of Alonnisos – Patitiri – is just 15 minutes from the hotel, a town that’s famous for its whitewashed streets, picturesque harbour, and sloping hillside location. Homegrown wine is a big hit around here and, if you’re itching for further adventures, you can always visit the harbour, hop on a ferry, and visit the neighbouring islands of Skiathos and Skopelos.  

Back in your studio, meanwhile, expect air-conditioning, understated Greek décor, a kitchenette, and a private balcony – some of which even boasting sweeping views of the Aegean Sea.

You may need to wait up to three hours at the port, depending on the ferry schedule. Your belongings can be stored locally if needed. A ferry will then transport you to Alonissos Island. From there, you'll take a transfer from the port of Alonissos to your chosen hotel. In the event of adverse weather conditions, where ferries are unable to operate, guests will be accommodated overnight in Skiathos before continuing to Alonissos the following day. The same applies for your return journey.

hotel.name: Ilias Studios
hotel.strapline: QUIET SPOT NEAR THE SOUTHERN COAST OF ALONISSOS
hotel.description:
Prefer to dial things down a bit on your holiday? Wake up at Ilias studios and you’ll be surrounded by tranquil gardens of fragrant flowers and pine trees to put you in a good mood. If that wasn’t enough, you’re also just a two-minute stroll from the main port of Alonnisos, so boat watching’s can be on the agenda if you fancy it.

But the day begins in your apartment and this hotel ticks all the right boxes. Think simple and self-catering with air-conditioning, a kitchenette, fridge, and tastefully understated Greek décor to put you at ease. You also get a private balcony, too.

Meanwhile, Patitiri – the capital and main port of Alonissos – is yours to explore at your own pace. The town is famous for its dense forests of pine trees and gently sloping terrain, which makes it an ideal place for hiking. Ilias Studio’s just a 10-minute stroll from Patiiri Beach, too, a collection of tiny bays with crystal-clear blue waters that’s irresistible to couples and families alike.

Foodies are well-served here. Simply take a stroll to the harbour and you’ll find a myriad of Greek restaurants and traditional tavernas to keep you occupied well into the evening.

hotel.name: Skiathos Telis
hotel.description:
Nestled high above the Aegean Sea, and just a 10-minute stroll from the shores of Agia Paraskevi Beach, holiday bases don’t come much better – or more relaxing – than these sleepy Skiathos apartments.

All great getaways start in the comfort of your room. At Telis Hotel, you get a kitchenette, fridge, air-conditioning, TV, and free Wi-Fi. All rooms come with a balcony, too, which provides eye-catching views of the Aegean Sea and wider landscape to help you settle into holiday mode. There's an outdoor terrace, too, which means you can sit back, relax, and watch the world drift by.

Meanwhile, golden sands and crystal-clear waters come together on the shores of Agia Paraskevi Beach. Grab a sunbed and soak up those rays or cool down with a dip in the Aegean Sea. In the distance, you’ll see the island of Ithaca and there’s a handful of beach bars and traditional tavernas nearby. 

And when evening falls, you’ll find plenty of bars, restaurants, and tourist hot spots dotted around the resort. Plus, don’t forget the hustle and bustle of Skiathos Town’s just a 10-minute taxi ride away.
hotel.ksp1: Just a 10-minute stroll from Agia Paraskevi Beach
hotel.ksp2: Self-catering apartments with a kitchenette, fridge, and free Wi-Fi

hotel.name: Paradise Hotel
hotel.strapline: Peaceful stay on the coast of Alonissos
hotel.description:
Nestled atop a rocky outcrop that juts into the shimmering water of the Aegean Sea, on the southeast coast of Alonissos, this hotel offers a laid-back charm that’ll have you feeling relaxed from the moment you arrive.

Days here are typically spent cooling off in the outdoor pool and sunbathing on the terraces, which are split across five levels with plenty of natural shade, overlooking the sea. Refreshing drinks and snacks are available at the pool bar, while the breakfast buffet will set you up perfectly for the day. 

Many cafes, bars and traditional tavernas can be found within easy walking distance in the compact but attractive village centre of Patitiri, so you’ll have plenty of options when it comes to eating out. A trip to the beach is always an option, too, with the nearest one just a 5-10 minute stroll away. 

If you’re after a low key Greek island escape in beautiful surroundings, this is the place to be.

hotel.description:
This charming, family-run hotel’s bagged an idyllic spot just above the port of Patitiri on the tranquil isle of Alonissos. So you can expect postcard-worthy views of the harbour and Aegean Sea if you stay at this small yet sparkling gem.

Recently refurbished rooms ensure that you’ll be spending your holiday in comfort, too. Plus, there’s free Wi-Fi, TV, tea-making facilities, and a safe box for storing you valuables. In the mornings, meanwhile, you can look forward to a large buffet-style breakfast in a fully air-conditioned dining room to help get your day off to the best possible start.

Craving a cocktail? The hotel bar’s extensive menu of classic beverages makes an excellent starting point for your evening adventure. And when you’re ready to depart, you’re just a short stroll from the harbourfront with its parade of traditional tavernas and local restaurants serving up traditional Greek cuisine.

hotel.name: Kanapitsa Mare Hotel
hotel.description:
Tucked away among pine trees and olive groves on a hillside overlooking the Aegean Sea, this family-run hotel offers a calm and peaceful base for a relaxing getaway in Skiathos. 

Days here are typically spent taking dips in the outdoor pool, basking in the sun with a drink in-hand on the terrace, or chilling on Tzaneria Beach, which is less than a five-minute stroll away – a popular spot for water sports as well as catching a tan. 

Interested in exploring more of what the island has to offer? Don’t hesitate to ask the staff for local tips and recommendations for excursions and activities. You can also take a taxi boat to Skiathos Town, where you’ll find lots of traditional whitewashed buildings and an excellent choice of places to eat and drink. 

As well as tucking into a fresh and plentiful buffet breakfast in the mornings, be sure to check out the Lithos bar and restaurant for authentic Greek cuisine later on, served on a delightful sea view terrace. The mojitos here are a particular highlight, but you’ll also find plenty of other cocktails, beers, wines and soft drinks on the menu.
hotel.ksp1: An outdoor pool and sun terrace with beautiful views overlooking the Aegean Sea
hotel.ksp2: Restaurant and bar serving authentic Greek cuisine and delicious cocktails

hotel.name: Rigas Hotel Skopelos
hotel.strapline: CHARMING HOTEL NEAR THE PORT OF CHORA
hotel.description:
Nestled amongst an idyllic landscape of colourful flowers and fragrant lemon trees, the Rigas Hotel will enchant you with its tasteful Greek architecture and generous helpings of old-world charm. What’s more, it places you within a 10-minute stroll from the island capital, Skopelos town.

The hotel’s small outdoor pool’s where you’ll do most of the relaxing around here. There’s a poolside bar, too, which means you’re always just a few feet away from a thirst-quenching drink. And, for a change of scenery, the nearby port of Chora is a sight to behold if you fancy a spot of boat-watching.

Breakfast, meanwhile, is a big deal at this hotel. It’s a buffet affair, which specialises in a variety of different dishes using the freshest ingredients available. However, at lunch and dinner, the restaurant transforms into a more intimate à la carte restaurant featuring set menus highlighting the very best local cuisine that Skopelos island has to offer.

Itching to see the sights? You’ll find an ancient temple just 200 metres from the port while the whitewashed buildings and courtyard tavernas of Skopelos Town are yours to explore at your own pace. Back in your room expect air-conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and a generously sized bed to help you settle down for the night.

Just so you know, this transfer includes a ferry crossing of approximately one hour. You will be taken from Skiathos Airport to the Port of Skiathos to catch the next available crossing. You may need to wait up to three hours at the port, depending on the ferry schedule. Your belongings can be stored locally if needed. A ferry will then transport you to Skopelos Island. From there, you'll take a transfer from the port of Skopelos to your chosen hotel. In the event of adverse weather conditions, where ferries are unable to operate, guests will be accommodated overnight in Skiathos before continuing to Skopelos the following day. The same applies for your return journey.

hotel.ksp2: Just a 10-minute stroll from picturesque Skopelos Town

hotel.name: Oniro Skiathos
hotel.description:
Nestled in the rolling hills of Skiathos island lies the Oniro – an ideal hideaway overlooking the Aegean sea. White cottages with classic red tile roofs are dotted across the large hotel-grounds, which feature a garden with olive groves – an idyllic Greek island set up.

There is a large pool with panoramic sea views where you can relax on the loungers and sip cocktails. The trek to and from the town is not for the faint hearted, so the hotel provides a free minibus two and from the town. If the beach is more your style then you’re in luck – the island has a number of beaches to choose from all within a ten to twenty minute drive from the hotel.

Authentic Greek and international cuisine is available from the hotel’s à la carte restaurant, which is a guest favourite. Don’t forget to fuel up in the mornings with the buffet breakfast, serving hot and cold foods.

All the rooms have contemporary decor which mirrors the natural, zen tones found across the island – so you can feel relaxed from dawn to dusk. Why not start the day by soaking up the garden and sea views on your balcony with a coffee?

If a laid-back island break sounds like your kind of holiday, Oniro might just be the place for you.

hotel.ksp2: Peaceful location

hotel.name: Bourtzi Hotel
hotel.strapline: MODERN HOTEL IN THE HEART OF SKIATHOS TOWN
hotel.description:
A bright and contemporary jewel in the old-school centre of Skiathos Town, this head-turning hotel puts you right in the thick of the holiday action. You’ll be just a 10-minute stroll from a sandy beach, too, so whether you’re looking for urban splendour or the clear-blue beauty of the Aegean Sea, staying here bags you the very best of both worlds.

Tucked away in the hotel courtyard resides a two-tiered swimming pool flanked by rows of sun loungers on both sides. Expect to spend a lot of time here when you’re not out exploring the wider delights of Skiathos Town. Craving a cocktail? Head to the lobby for an extensive menu of creative concoctions that’ll tingle your tastebuds with every sip. You can grab a snack here, too, if you’re feeling a little peckish.

Venture out, meanwhile, and you’ll find plenty of attractions and places of cultural interest to discover. Skiathos Spiti – a museum that provides a fascinating insight into the Greek way of life over the centuries – is just a two-minute stroll away, while wandering a minute from the hotel will take you to the calm waters and quaint fishing boats of Skiathos Harbour. Restaurants and bars can be found in all directions, too – ranging from traditional tavernas and eateries to places serving up international cuisine to satisfy the fussiest food snobs.

In the mornings, you can expect a huge array of English and Continental dishes at the hotel’s breakfast buffet. All served poolside to help get your day off to the best possible start.

Just so you know, all drop off points are approximately 250m from the hotel.
hotel.ksp1: Located near plenty of restaurants, bar, and tourist attractions
hotel.ksp2: Just a 10-minute stroll from the beach

hotel.name: Atrium Hotel
hotel.description:
Built into a pine-covered hillside directly overlooking the glistening water of the Aegean Sea, this family-run hotel on the south coast of Skiathos is a genuine delight. The setting here is second to none – think traditional stone walls, terracotta rooftops and beautifully landscaped gardens. 

When it comes to swimming and sunbathing, choose between the outdoor pool which sits on the sea view terrace, or the golden sand beach, Agia Paraskevi, that’s just a few minutes’ stroll away down the hill. With a fitness room, a sauna, billiards and table tennis facilities on-site, you’ll never find yourself at a loose end here. 

Keen to explore more of what the island has to offer? Be sure to enquire about the range of excursions available to book, from hiking and cycling to Greek cooking classes and boat trips. 

A buffet breakfast beneath the shade of mulberry trees and bougainvillaea is the perfect way to start your mornings, while the hotel’s very own taverna serves up an à la carte menu of Greek and Mediterranean classics for lunch. If you fancy eating in later on as well, you can look forward to a plentiful Greek buffet on the poolside terrace. 

Much like the rest of the hotel, the rooms feature an elegant blend of traditional and contemporary décor, with earthy colour tones and timber accents creating a warm, cosy ambience.

hotel.ksp2: Outdoor pool, fitness room, and sauna

hotel.name: Kassandra Bay Resort And Spa
hotel.strapline: RELAXING RETREAT NEAR THE AEGAEAN SEA
hotel.description:
Everything is just that little bit more luxurious at Kassandra Bay Resort and Spa – a glamorous hotel overlooking the crystal-blue waters of Vasilias Bay in Skiathos. From the picturesque location and stunning seaside views to its host of upmarket facilities, nothing has been spared to ensure you have the best holiday ever. They're serious about sustainability, too, and have been eco-certified by Green and Travelife.

First off, let’s talk the beach – a gorgeous sandy stretch of shoreline that’s just a five-minute stroll from the hotel. Things tend to be on the quieter side here, although water sports are available – such as waterskiing, wakeboarding, and stand-up paddling – if you fancy something a bit more up-tempo. There are a handful of bars nearby, too.

Back at the hotel, you can look forward to lazing by two shimmering saltwater pools complete with a poolside bar for when that inevitable cocktail craving kicks in. Fancy a spot of lunch? Head to nearby Pelagos Restaurant for a menu of mouth-watering Greek cuisine served within stunning panoramic surroundings. There’s fine dining on the menu, too, courtesy of the unforgettable dishes at Mesoyios. Top tip: Mesoyios tends to get very busy so book ahead to ensure you don’t miss out.

Ready for a change of scenery? Catch a water taxi from the jetty to Skiathos’s old port in just 10 minutes. It’s then just a five-minute stroll to the main street of Papadiamanti and all its bars, restaurants, and shops brimming with souvenirs for the flight home. Back at the hotel, treat yourself to an invigorating head-to-toe massage or sink slowly into a bubbling Jacuzzi and let those troubles melt away.

hotel.name: Elivi Skiathos
hotel.description:
With a picturesque setting amidst a thicket of olive and pine trees, Elivi Skiathos might just have it all. We’re talking beachfront location, swish pool scene, luxe spa, and a whole host of family-friendly ways to fill your days – what more could you need? 

This place goes big on the beach access – there are four within walking distance, including the popular Koukounaries beach that comes with a slew of bars and restaurants and a long belt of powdery-soft sand. If you prefer to kick back poolside, meanwhile, there are two swim spots to choose from, with plenty of thick, comfy sun loungers to go around, and a pool bar to ensure you’re never without a cocktail. 

For any youngsters you’ve got in tow, the kids’ club offering here will be sure to score points. From kids’ Pilates and yoga to creative workshops and trips to the nearby lake and wetlands, there’s plenty to keep little ones entertained. And if you manage to snag a few hours for yourself, the spa is a hub of relaxation with an indoor heated pool, sauna, hammam, and fitness centre. And if you fancy treating yourself, they’ve got a tempting selection of massages and therapies, too. 

And you can expect to be well fed during your stay as well. Breakfast is a delightful buffet of freshly cooked favourites, while for lunch you can pick between a beachfront taverna that specialises in fish, and a Mediterranean trattoria that serves pizzas and pastas. Come dinnertime two more places open their doors – a sophisticated Mediterranean spot and a Japanese meat joint. 

There’s practically a bar for every eventuality here, too. Watering holes are pitched up along the shoreline of all four beaches, as well as by each pool, so you’re well and truly sorted on that front. Finally, there’s a sophisticated tapas and cocktail bar where you can grab a drink or a bite to eat and soak up the vibes.
hotel.ksp1: Four beaches within walking distance
hotel.ksp2: Two pools, a fun-filled kids’ club, and a spa

hotel.name: Marpunta Resort by Santikos Collection
hotel.strapline: Serene stay on an idyllic peninsula
hotel.description:
Picture a peaceful, forested peninsula in the midst of a national marine park, where a gentle hill slopes down towards the shimmering water of the Aegean Sea. That’s the unique setting of this dreamy hotel on the southern tip of Alonissos, a Greek island renowned for its tranquil, unspoilt nature. 

You’ll have access to three gorgeous private beaches here, along with an outdoor pool where you can bask in the sunshine and swim to your heart’s content. Fancy some tennis? There’s a court available to rent out (for an extra charge). You can also get involved in yoga sessions or treat yourself to soothing massages, while children will enjoy the shallow pool and playground. 

A variety of delicious Mediterranean and Greek dishes are served at the main buffet restaurant, which offers stunning views overlooking the bay, while the à la carte beachfront restaurant is the perfect spot to tuck into authentic local cuisine, inspired by fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Drinks and snacks are served throughout the day at the poolside bar, and there’s another drinking spot in the lobby, too. 

The elegant, whitewashed rooms are dotted among cobbled walkways lined by colourful bougainvillaea, set out in the style of a traditional fisherman’s village to create a quintessentially Alonissian ambience. 

Just so you know, this transfer includes a ferry crossing of approximately two hours. You will be taken from Skiathos Airport to the Port of Skiathos to catch the next available crossing. You may need to wait up to three hours at the port, depending on the ferry schedule. Your belongings can be stored locally if needed. A ferry will then transport you to Alonissos Island. From there, you'll take a transfer from the port of Alonissos to your chosen hotel. In the event of adverse weather conditions, where ferries are unable to operate, guests will be accommodated overnight in Skiathos before continuing to Alonissos the following day. The same applies for your return journey.
hotel.ksp1: Serene setting in a marine national park, with access to three private beaches
hotel.ksp2: Beachfront à la carte restaurant serving authentic Greek cuisine

hotel.name: Skiathos Palace Hotel
hotel.description:
Nestled on a hillside shrouded in pine trees and overlooking the crystal-clear water of Koukounaries Beach, this hotel’s idyllic location is just the start of what's to love about this place. Expect top-notch facilities, a relaxed pool scene, and sweeping views that you won’t forget in a hurry.

Lazing on a sun lounger by the hotel swimming pool is one of the top pastimes around here, with occasional visit to the poolside bar for a refreshing drink. Prefer the beach? You’re spoilt for choice with two sandy stretches within walking distance. The nearest is just a five-minute stroll away, and you can head a similar distance in another different direction for the splendour and lively water sports of Koukounaries Beach.

Stomach rumbling? That’s your cue to head to the hotel’s main restaurant – a buffet affair that boasts a wide range of dishes that’ll satisfy the biggest appetites. But, if traditional Greek cuisine tickles your fancy, book a table at the White View Restaurant, and enjoy the à la carte offering set against a picturesque backdrop of the North Aegean Sea. 

Your entire holiday could be spent at the hotel but venturing out brings its own rich rewards. Hikers will be in their element, too, as the island boasts 25 recognised hiking routes that’ll get you up-close and personal with nature like never before.

Just so you you know, air conditioning and tea and coffee making facilities are available in every room throughout the season at this hotel.

hotel.name: Radisson Resort Plaza Skiathos
hotel.strapline: Trendy stay on the Kanapitsa Peninsula
hotel.description:
Tucked away amongst olive groves and pine trees is this modern and minimalist sanctuary by the sea. Up on a quiet hillside with sweeping sea views, it’s just a two-minute walk down to sandy Tzaneria Beach. From there, you can hop on a water taxi for a speedy, scenic way to reach Skiathos Town.

Surrounded by sun loungers and bean bags you’ll soon want to sink into, the double rectangular pool is the perfect place to chill out and cool off. The beachy, contemporary aesthetic brings an Instagrammable Ibiza vibe to the poolside, and beyond.

Start your day right with a plate piled high from the varied breakfast buffet. Lunch and dinner options are à la carte, with Greek and Mediterranean dishes taking centre stage on the rotating evening menu. The poolside bar is where it’s at for hot and cold drinks, and snacks throughout the day. The cosy lobby bar, meanwhile, is your go-to spot for a pre-dinner tipple or nightcap.

Bright and stylish, each room features air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a fridge, tea and coffee-making facilities, and a safe, as well as robes and slippers.
hotel.ksp1: Quiet, hillside location with sea views
hotel.ksp2: Two-minute walk to a sandy beach and water taxi pickup

hotel.name: KB Ammos
hotel.description:
Looking for a stylish, sophisticated and stress-free getaway in Skiathos? This eco-friendly boutique hotel ticks all the boxes.

It’s in a super convenient location, less than a five-minute stroll from Megali Ammos beach and around a 10-minute stroll from the charming centre of Skiathos Town, allowing you to enjoy the best of both. 

When you’re not sunbathing on the shores of the Aegean Sea or exploring the local area, the outdoor pool and sun terrace is the perfect spot to unwind with a cocktail in-hand from the poolside bar. 

Kick-start your mornings with a deliciously fresh buffet breakfast on the veranda, featuring an array of Greek products from local producers. If you get peckish during the day, meanwhile, the poolside bar is on-hand with snacks and light meals – and you’ll also find an abundance of authentic tavernas within easy walking distance.
hotel.ksp1: Less than a five-minute walk to the beach and around 10 minutes into Skiathos Town
hotel.ksp2: Outdoor pool and poolside bar serving a selection of refreshing drinks and snacks

hotel.name: Kassandra Bay Suites And Spa
hotel.description:
Exclusive, sophisticated, and right on Visilias Bay… need we say more? Tucked into a corner of the wider Kassandra Bay Resort is the adults-only hideaway Kassandra Bay Suites – a serene spot that’s tailor-made for unwinding.  

Kick off your days at the breakfast buffet, where you’ll find a bountiful selection of local international favourites. An al fresco lunch spot serves up Greek cuisine in the afternoons, while two more restaurants are open for dinner – one dealing in laid-back meals, the other in fine dining. And a couple of bars will ensure your glass is never empty.

Spend long, lazy afternoons on the beach or take a dip in the hotel's saltwater pools, including one that’s reserved just for guests of the suites side of the resort. For those with the taste for the buzz of city life, the vibrant streets of Skiathos are just a 10-minute taxi ride away. Whatever you decide, hotel's concierge are on hand 24/7 to help you organise excursions, restaurant reservations, and anything else you might need during your stay.
hotel.ksp1: Nearby beach within walking distance
hotel.ksp2: Three restaurants and a poolside bar

hotel.name: Skiathos Princess Resort
hotel.strapline: Beachside luxury for the whole family
hotel.description:
Get ready for five-star bliss by the beach. With direct access to one of the finest sandy stretches in the area, you can look forward to swimming and sunbathing just a few metres from your front door. Located in the south of Skiathos, this family-friendly hotel is surrounded by beautiful gardens and is only a 15-minute taxi ride from Skiathos Airport.

Travelling with little ones? The hotel provides family rooms, a kids’ club, an outdoor playground, a child-friendly pool, and meal options for children. Adults are taken care of, too, with a hot tub, spa, fitness room, and a large pool. Elegant and air-conditioned, each room offers WiFi, luxury toiletries, and friendly 24/7 room service. In addition, your private balcony promises views over the ocean or the hotel’s gardens.

If great food and drink are top of your holiday wish list, you’ll be excited to know that this place has three restaurants and bars on site. From local delicacies to international dishes, a wide range of flavours are available, plus there’s a rich buffet breakfast served every morning.
hotel.ksp1: Direct access to the golden sands of Agia Paraskevi Beach
hotel.ksp2: Little ones will love the kids’ club, playground, pool, and children’s menu

hotel.name: Aegean Suites by Santikos Collection
hotel.description:
With the intimacy of a boutique hotel, and the service and facilities of a five-star resort, the Aegean Suites is something special. The secret ingredient? Super friendly staff who are renowned for going above and beyond. The peaceful and pretty location, overlooking the Aegean Sea and only a 20-minute walk from Skiathos Town, doesn’t hurt either.

With a large pool, lined by comfy, cushioned sunbeds and an open-air Jacuzzi, you might be happy staying put, but there’s also a public beach right across the road. Alternatively,  get the free shuttle over to sister hotel, Princess Resort, to make the most of their private beach, pool, beach club and spa. Back at base, check out the gym or book a scuba diving or hiking experience directly with the hotel.

À la carte breakfasts are served in the terrace restaurant, which also plates up gourmet Greek and Mediterranean dishes each evening. Snacks and light lunches are available at the poolside restaurant, and you can head to the pool bar to quench your thirst with freshly-made juices, smoothies and cocktails – you might even catch one of the hotel’s regular live music nights. 

All rooms feature an outdoor terrace or balcony with views of the sea or tranquil gardens.

Just so you know, this hotel only accepts guests over the age of 16.
hotel.ksp1: Intimate, adults-only hotel with a large pool and Jacuzzi
hotel.ksp2: Access to facilities at sister hotel via free shuttle
